plainTranslation:
This person may seem to understand you right away. Conversation often feels easy, as if they naturally follow your train of thought and quickly pick up on what matters to you.

When this works well, it can feel deeply affirming. They may notice parts of you that often go unseen and reflect them back in a way that resonates. You might feel that they are paying close attention, not just to what you say, but to the energy, intentions, and essence behind it. Their observations can help you feel witnessed in a meaningful way, as though they are looking past the obvious and connecting with something more fundamental about who you are.

Being understood by them can feel like exhaling. You may feel less guarded, less alone in your experience, and more able to be yourself without explanation. At times, they may find the words for something you have always felt but never fully named.

Remember that feeling understood is not the same as someone knowing everything about you. This person may think they know what you mean before you have finished explaining.

Keep sharing who you are as you grow and change. The real gift here is staying open, curious, and willing to keep learning about each other.
